title: Non-mosaic Down syndrome
summary: Non-mosaic Down syndrome documented by chromosomal analysis OR by clinical findings consistent with non-mosaic Down syndrome.

children.criterion: Non-mosaic Down syndrome documented by chromosomal analysis (47,XX,+21 or 47,XY,+21 karyotype)
Non-mosaic Down syndrome documented by clinical findings consistent with the diagnosis (without genetic confirmation), made by an acceptable medical source
